quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go. Do not come back weak.

steps.journal: Find Palidan Talimas in Thedruk: east from Tethelin to the river, then south past the third hill.
steps.says: Two crystals from the Taksehir miners, and two warbeads for the Coldwind Guard of Halas. Here is my token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-tank.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-1-good/L49, so a Group 1 paladin is sent on. The Talimas's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.name: The Recruiter
quests.offer: Lord Tearis Thex spoke of you. Your path is walked; now the epic. Palidan Talimas has work only the strongest can do. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go. Do not come back weak.

steps.says: Two crystals from the Taksehir miners, and two warbeads for the Coldwind Guard of Halas. Here is my token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-tank.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-2-good/L49, so a Group 2 warrior is sent on. The Talimas's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.name: Crystals and Warbeads
quests.offer: Bring me two crystals off the Taksehir miners in the west of the Great Waste. Then help the Coldwind Guard of Halas: goblins attack the treants of Guardian Forest. Bring two of their warbeads.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Taksehir miners in the west of the Great Waste for two glowing crystals.
Kill the goblin soothsayers and assassins attacking the treants in north-west Guardian Forest for two enchanted warbeads.
Bring the crystals, the warbeads and my token to Palidan Talimas.
steps.says: Good. Now go deep into Guk, to the froglok herbalist. He makes what we need.
steps.notyet: The crystals and the warbeads, and my token with them.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-tank.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The Taksehir miners are level 60, the guide warns: hard to solo.

quests.name: The Froglok Herbalist
quests.offer: The froglok herbalist, at the bottom of Guk past two bridges, needs three things for his potion: a spotted tongue, congealed swamp water and mycanoid spores. Guard him while he brews.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill froglok channelers in Guk for a spotted tongue.
Kill froglok channelers in Guk for congealed swamp water.
Kill fungal cavaliers and hunters deep in Guk for mycanoid spores.
Bring the three ingredients to the froglok herbalist at the bottom of Guk, past two bridges.
steps.says: The ingredients! Guard me while I brew: they will come for me. Here, drink this when it is done.

steps.journal: Bring the herbalist's potion to Palidan Talimas.
steps.says: It is done. You may call yourself one of us.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-tank.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's hour of waves round the herbalist (watchmen, guardsmen, a lookout and a scout, bouncers) and his port to a man in south Guk are not in: he brews the potion when given the ingredients. The 20,000,000 experience is the other episode ones' (this guide names none).

quests.name: Bandits at the North Gate
quests.offer: Bandits rob travellers just outside the north entrance of Freeport, by the signpost on the road. Let them take your purse, then kill the leader and bring me his.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Wait outside Freeport's north gate, by the signpost, with 200 tunar on you for the bandits.

events.text: Three bandits come up the road and brush past you. Your purse is lighter! The brigand in the middle has it.

steps.journal: Kill the bandit brigand and take the coin purse.
Bring the coin purse to Palidan Talimas.
steps.says: Justice, then. Jakai, in the fort on top of the mountain in Diren Hold, will teach you more of it.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-tank.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's two popups stealing 100 tunar each are one; no tunar is taken.

quests.name: Jakai's Three Treasures
quests.offer: Justice is learned. Bring me two swords and a ring from the siren camps' chests: Vastly Deep, West Toxx and Kerra Isle. Kill a plagued siren for its gland while you are there.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill enchanting sirens at the siren camp of Vastly Deep (east) for a waterlogged key.
Open the waterlogged chest at the siren camp of Vastly Deep (east) with the key.
Kill enchanting sirens at the siren camp of West Toxx (south-west) for a waterlogged key.
Open the waterlogged chest at the siren camp of West Toxx (south-west) with the key.
Kill enchanting sirens at the siren camp of Kerra Isle (south-west) for a waterlogged key.
Open the waterlogged chest at the siren camp of Kerra Isle (south-west) with the key.
Kill a plagued siren at the siren camps for its toxic gland.
Bring the ring and the two swords to Jakai.
steps.says: Now pass judgment on Calidux, at the bottom of the main building of Qeynos Prison.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-tank.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide does not name the ring or the swords: the names are ours. Any chest takes any key here (the guide's keys look alike and each fits one camp's chest).

quests.name: The Judgment of Calidux
quests.offer: Calidux is held at the bottom of the main building of Qeynos Prison. Hear his story, then judge.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Give the toxic siren gland to Calidux at the bottom of Qeynos Prison.
steps.says: An undead menace walks Basher's Enclave: An Ancient Corpse. With this gland I can weaken it. Slay it, and bring me its soul.

steps.journal: Go to the north of Basher's Enclave, where An Ancient Corpse rests.

events.text: The ground splits, and An Ancient Corpse rises!

steps.journal: Kill An Ancient Corpse and take its soul.
Bring the ancient corpse's soul to Calidux.
steps.says: The soul! Mine at last... and now, you!

steps.journal: Kill Calidux, who has turned on you, and take his journal.
Bring Calidux's journal to Jakai.
steps.says: So that was his justice. You have earned this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-tank.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's choice (the gland's weakening potion, or slaying the corpse unweakened) is the first: the gland goes to Calidux. An Ancient Corpse stands in Basher's Enclave always (the guide's is triggered and leaves after twenty minutes). Calidux is made attackable by this set's seed.

quests.name: Shinlos's Test
quests.offer: You have a prejudice in you, and Shinlos will find it. He waits outside the north gate of Freeport, along the wall to the west. Do what he says.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Shinlos outside Freeport's north gate, along the wall to the west.
steps.says: Go and wait by the two palm trees to the north-west, before the road. Whatever comes, keep your heart.

steps.journal: Wait by the two palm trees north-west of Shinlos.

events.text: This is the place. Stay here.

steps.journal: Speak with the crying maiden who comes to the palm trees.
steps.says: My little brother is lost! Please, you must help me!

choices.says: ...Shinlos's voice: "You leave your post at the first cry." Try again.
Then he is dead. She runs off into the dark.

steps.journal: Look at the chest that has appeared by the palm trees.

choices.says: The lid will not lift while your hand is greedy.
The chest fades away.

steps.journal: Face the smiling demon by the palm trees.
steps.says: I will not fight back, and my loot is great. Strike me down!

choices.says: He laughs. "So easily led."
He floats away, disappointed.

steps.journal: Return to Shinlos.
steps.says: You kept your heart. Now my sister: the pirates of Cape Dreg hold her, in the cave under the great ship.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-tank.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's fifteen-minute waits are not in; the three temptations are talk steps with choices (any answer but No is a wrong one, said and asked again). The maiden, the chest and the demon are ours by name (the guide names none).

quests.name: Synder of the Indigo
quests.offer: My sister is in the cave on the island with the great ship off Cape Dreg. Fall through the floor into the hidden room, and bring as many friends as you can.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Swim out to the island with the great ship off Cape Dreg, go in, and drop through the floor into the hidden room.

events.text: It seems someone is hiding in here... The spirits of Syndar rise from the walls!

steps.journal: Kill the spirits of Syndar.
Kill the Syndar manifestations.
Kill the Syndar incantations.
Kill Synder of the Indigo and take his necklace. Overmax your fire resistance: he lowers it.
Speak with Synder's ghost in the cubby under the ramp, quickly.
steps.says: You have freed me, and the one I held. Go, tell them it is over.

steps.journal: Return to Shinlos.
steps.says: She is free. Go to the monastery of Shon-To, outside Moradhim, and speak with Ediopolus by the lake.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-tank.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's raid and its five waves are kill steps; Synder's ghost stands in the cubby always. The 100,000,000 experience is the evil guides' episode 3 figure (this guide names none).

steps.journal: Find Sensei Melinus on the large hill by a large rock, north-east of Qeynos Prison.
steps.says: Ghostly goo first, from the undead of Centaur Valley. Carry my token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-1-good/L49, so a Group 1 bard is sent on. The Melinus's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.name: Goo and Warbeads
quests.offer: Bring me two ghostly goos from the undead of east Centaur Valley, then two enchanted goblin warbeads from north-west Guardian Forest.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the wandering ghosts by the broken bridge in east Centaur Valley, up the river from Blackwater, for ghostly goo.
Bring the two ghostly goos and my token to Sensei Melinus.
steps.says: Good. Now the warbeads.

steps.journal: Kill the goblin soothsayers and assassins attacking the treants in north-west Guardian Forest for two enchanted warbeads.
Bring the two warbeads to Sensei Melinus.
steps.says: Now Guk. The High Shaman there needs three pages of pardon for a prisoner.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Pages of Pardon
quests.offer: The High Shaman inside Guk will pardon a prisoner for three pages. Find them, give them to him, and keep the prisoner alive.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the Elder Froglok Guk Mystic, off the circle bridge in Guk, for the first page of pardon.
Kill frogloks in Guk until the Elder Froglok Guk Diviner comes, for the second page.
Kill fungal cavaliers and hunters deep in Guk until an elder fungal comes, for the third page.
Bring the three pages of pardon to the High Shaman in Guk.
steps.says: Pardon, for the prisoner. Now protect him: the bloodletters will come for him.

steps.journal: Protect the prisoner: kill the froglok bloodletters that come for him.
Speak with the High Shaman again.
steps.says: He is safe. Go back to the one who sent you.

steps.journal: Return to Sensei Melinus on the hill north-east of Qeynos Prison.
steps.says: The prisoner lives. You are ready for more.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's six waves of bloodletters over an hour are a kill step of six (copies brought for the step); the elder froglok mystic and diviner and the elder fungal stand in Guk always (the guide's come in place of the channelers and fungals killed).

quests.name: Celedonicus's Sashes
quests.offer: Bandits in the middle of Tak'Xiv wear sashes. Bring me four.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the desert bandits in the middle of Tak'Xiv for four sashes.
Bring the four sashes to Celedonicus in the bards' guild of Qeynos.
steps.says: Four friends of mine need help: Jezia, Adiliv, Nicton and Mervol. Help them all.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Jezia's Locket
quests.offer: My locket was taken by the frogloks of Burial Mounds, the slayers and inquisitors. Bring it back.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill froglok slayers and inquisitors in south-west Burial Mounds for Jezia's locket.
Bring the locket to Jezia, by a tree outside the castle in south-west Qeynos.
steps.says: My locket! Tell Celedonicus I am grateful.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's note to deliver in Freeport is not in (the guide does not name for whom).

quests.name: Adiliv's Voice
quests.offer: An enchanting siren of the Vastly Deep stole my voice. Bring it back to me.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill enchanting sirens in the east of the Vastly Deep for Adiliv's voice.
Bring the voice to Adiliv, by the pool in Arcadin.
steps.says: My voice! Thank Celedonicus for me.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Nicton's Eyelash
quests.offer: I need the eyelash of one of the eyes of the Elephant Graveyard. Bring me one.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the eyes of the Elephant Graveyard for an eyelash.
Bring the eyelash to Nicton, in the dwarf camp east of the Gerntar's Mine coach.
steps.says: Just what I needed. Celedonicus chose his friends well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Nicton is the server's Nickton. The guide's "Eyes in EG" are evil eyes placed at the Elephant Graveyard (ours).

quests.name: Jebodan's Price
quests.offer: Jebodan, in the manor house across from me, holds something of mine. He wants 5,000 tunar. Pay him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Pay Jebodan 5,000 tunar in the manor house across from Mervol in Darvar Manor.
steps.says: Five thousand. Tell Mervol we are square.

steps.journal: Return to Mervol, by the tree near the Darvar Manor coach.
steps.says: Square, at last. My thanks, and Celedonicus's.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's price is "5k (maybe more or less depending on your choice)": 5,000 here.

quests.name: Graal the Leviathan
quests.offer: Graal the Leviathan, a serpent as long as a ship, hunts the coast north-west of Qeynos. Kill it and bring me its scale.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Run up the coast from the castle to the north-west of Qeynos, where Graal the Leviathan hunts.

events.text: The sea heaves. A serpent as long as a ship comes out of the water: Graal the Leviathan!

steps.journal: Kill Graal the Leviathan and take a sea serpent's scale.
Bring the scale to Celedonicus.
steps.says: Graal is dead. Take what you have earned.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Graal stands on the coast always (the guide's moves from land to water; its runes of earth and tide are not in). The 30,000,000 experience and 10,000 tunar are the other episode 2s' (this guide names none).

quests.name: The Ravenous Bear
quests.offer: Something terrorizes the elves of Tethelin. Go to the bluish ice in the middle of Fayspire Gate and see.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find the circle of bluish ice in the middle of Fayspire Gate and step into it.

events.text: The ice groans under you. A ravenous bear comes out of the blue!

steps.journal: Kill the ravenous bear.
Find Gelledyn, the only white-faced one, in Tethelin.
steps.says: A bear made mad by vampires. Randarith, Raldarith and Quil'Eyne hide in the Greyvax Caves, north-west. Bring me proof of them.

events.text: Vampires walk the woods of Tethelin.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Vampires of Greyvax
quests.offer: Randarith, Raldarith and Quil'Eyne hide in the Greyvax Caves, north-west. Bring me the blood of all three.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Randarith in the Greyvax Caves for his blood. He hits hard but falls fast.
Kill Raldarith in the Greyvax Caves for his blood. Nearly nothing hurts him.
Keep Quil'Eyne in the basement of the Greyvax Caves and kill him for quil'eyne's blood.
Bring the three bloods to Gelledyn in Tethelin.
steps.says: Tethelin is safe. Go to the monastery of Shon-To, east of Moradhim, and speak with Ediopolus by the lake.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-melee.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The bloods are the database's Randerith's and Raldithar's blood. The 100,000,000 experience is the evil guides' episode 3 figure (this guide says only "experience").

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-caster.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-1-good/L49, so a Group 1 wizard, alchemist is sent on. The Magi'Kot's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.offer: Bring me two ghostly goos off the powerful undead of east Centaur Valley, and two enchanted war beads from the goblins of north-west Guardian Forest.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the wandering ghosts by the broken bridge in east Centaur Valley, up the river from Blackwater, for ghostly goo.
Bring the two ghostly goos and my token to Magi'Kot.
steps.says: Now the war beads.

steps.journal: Kill the goblin soothsayers and assassins attacking the treants in north-west Guardian Forest for two enchanted warbeads.
Bring the two warbeads to Magi'Kot.
steps.says: Now the last of it: the heart and brain of Aktana the Flamekissed, in the east of Lavastorm, and his soul.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-caster.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Aktana the Flamekissed
quests.offer: Aktana the Flamekissed sleeps in a gargoyle statue in the east of Lavastorm. Give it a heart, then a brain, and bring me his soul.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill animated lava in the east of Lavastorm until one holds the heart of Aktana.
Place the heart in the gargoyle statue of Aktana, north of the lava.

events.text: The statue takes the heart and stirs. Round the mountain to the north, gargoyle patrollers wake.

steps.journal: Kill the gargoyle patrollers north round the mountain until the fire imp protector comes, and take the brain.
Bring the brain to the statue of Aktana.

events.text: The statue cracks open. Aktana the Flamekissed steps out, burning!

steps.journal: Kill Aktana the Flamekissed and take Aktana's soul.
Bring Aktana's soul to Magi'Kot.
steps.says: His soul is mine. You have done well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-caster.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The statue is a place to reach by the patrollers; the patrollers' fire imp protector and Aktana stand there always (the guide's are spawned by the heart and the brain).

quests.name: The Brigand's Purse
quests.offer: Bandits trouble Freeport's north gate. Carry 500 tunar for them to steal, then kill the brigand in the middle and bring me his coin purse.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Wait outside Freeport's north gate, by the signpost, with 500 tunar on you for the bandits.

events.text: Three bandits come up the road and brush past you. Your purse is lighter! The brigand in the middle has it.

steps.journal: Kill the bandit brigand and take the coin purse.
Bring the coin purse to Magi'Kot.
steps.says: Now I can summon Vylinnuza, with three gems made of six fragments.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-caster.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's bandits walk through Freeport and leave; here the brigand waits by the gate.

quests.name: Six Fragments
quests.offer: Three fragments drop from the enchanting sirens of Kerra Isle, West Toxx and the Vastly Deep; three more lie in their chests, opened with keys the sirens carry. Bring me all six.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill enchanting sirens at any of the three camps for a fragment of logic.
Kill enchanting sirens for a fragment of passion.
Kill enchanting sirens for a fragment of restraint.
Kill enchanting sirens at the siren camp of Kerra Isle (south-west) for a waterlogged key.
Open the waterlogged chest at the siren camp of Kerra Isle (south-west) with the key.
Kill enchanting sirens at the siren camp of the Vastly Deep (east) for a waterlogged key.
Open the waterlogged chest at the siren camp of the Vastly Deep (east) with the key.
Kill enchanting sirens at the siren camp of West Toxx (south-west) for a waterlogged key.
Open the waterlogged chest at the siren camp of West Toxx (south-west) with the key.
Bring the six fragments to Magi'Kot.
steps.says: Logic with calculation, passion with motivation, complacency with restraint: three gems.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-caster.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Magi'Kot fuses the fragments (the guide: the player, with a jeweler's kit).

quests.name: Vylinnuza of the Tide
quests.offer: With the three gems I can call Vylinnuza of the Tide. Bring a raid. Kill her, and bring me her soul.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Tell Magi'Kot you are ready.
steps.says: Then come, Vylinnuza!

steps.journal: Kill Vylinnuza of the Tide and take her soul. Max your cold resistance.
Bring Vylinnuza's soul to Magi'Kot.
steps.says: The tide is mine. Take your reward.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-caster.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Vylinnuza stands by Magi'Kot always (FrontiersForge's place).

quests.name: Boldunder
quests.offer: Find Boldunder in the deserts of Odus: at the base of a hill near a great depression in the middle of the North Barren Coast. Bring me one of his souls.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Go to the hill by the great depression in the middle of the North Barren Coast.

events.text: You feel the ground rumbling under your feet. It is coming up toward the depression!

steps.journal: Kill Boldunder and take his soul.
Bring Boldunder's soul to Magi'Kot.
steps.says: Now speak with me again, and I will take you to the Plane of Sky for the last summoning.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-caster.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Boldunder stands by the depression always (the guide's comes after three popups), at EQOA-Data's map point laid over Odus (the seed's fit).

quests.name: Ahriaana the Ultimate
quests.offer: Gather twenty or more. I will take you to the Plane of Sky, where I will call Ahriaana the Ultimate. Kill her, and bring my ghost a page of her journal.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Magi'Kot to be taken to the Plane of Sky.
steps.says: Hold on to something.

steps.journal: Kill Ahriaana the Ultimate. Pets are the way; she sends away those she hates.
Bring the torn journal page to Magi'Kot's ghost, who roams near the pagoda.
steps.says: It is over. Go to the monastery of Shon-To, outside Moradhim, and speak with Ediopolus by the lake.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-caster.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Magi'Kot's port lands by Trixie Longwings on the Plane of Sky (ours: the guide's "first island, where the Isle of Wonder port is" has no recorded place here); Ahriaana and the ghost stand there always. Her hour's full heal is not in. The 100,000,000 experience is ours (the evil guides' episode 3 figure).

quests.name: The Recruiter
quests.offer: Crikston Gundlefop spoke of you. Your path is walked; now the epic. Ruddish the Devout has work only the strongest can do. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go. Do not come back weak.

steps.journal: Find Ruddish the Devout on the river bank on the south-west border of the Spider Mines.
steps.says: Summoner's wands and goblin warbeads, to begin. Carry my token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-1-good/L49, so a Group 1 cleric is sent on. The Ruddish's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.name: The Recruiter
quests.offer: Lord Tearis Thex spoke of you. Your path is walked; now the epic. Ruddish the Devout has work only the strongest can do. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.

steps.says: Summoner's wands and goblin warbeads, to begin. Carry my token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-2-good/L49, so a Group 2 shaman is sent on. The Ruddish's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.name: The Recruiter
quests.offer: Daresh spoke of you. Your path is walked; now the epic. Ruddish the Devout has work only the strongest can do. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go. Do not come back weak.

steps.journal: Find Ruddish the Devout on the river bank on the south-west border of the Spider Mines.
steps.says: Summoner's wands and goblin warbeads, to begin. Carry my token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-3-good/L49, so a Group 3 druid is sent on. The Ruddish's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.name: Wands and Warbeads
quests.offer: Bring me two summoner's wands from the frogloks of south-west Burial Mounds, and two enchanted goblin warbeads from north-west Guardian Forest.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill froglok slayers and inquisitors by the river in south-west Burial Mounds for two summoner's wands.
Kill the goblin soothsayers and assassins attacking the treants in north-west Guardian Forest for two enchanted warbeads.
Bring the wands, the warbeads and my token to Ruddish the Devout.
steps.says: Now three ores from the fire basilisks of Lavastorm, and what they call up.
steps.notyet: The wands and the warbeads, and my token with them.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The wands are the database's froglok summoner's wands.

quests.name: The Megametamilipizon
quests.offer: Farm the fire basilisks of Lavastorm for smoldering bedrock, mesothermal platinum and epithermal gold. Drop them in the lava where the land dips. Bring me what climbs out.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill fire basilisks in Lavastorm for smoldering bedrock.
Kill fire basilisks for mesothermal platinum.
Kill fire basilisks for epithermal gold.
Drop the three ores into the lava where the land dips, in the middle of Lavastorm.

events.text: The ores melt into the lava. It boils, and something vast and many-legged climbs out of it: the Megametamilipizon!

steps.journal: Kill the Megametamilipizon and take its mandible.
Bring the Megametamilipizon's mandible to Ruddish the Devout.
steps.says: You have done it. Come back to me when you are rested.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The named millipedes before the Megametamilipizon are not in: it rises when the ores melt. The 20,000,000 experience is the other episode ones' (this guide names none).

quests.name: Sothimus the Brigand
quests.offer: Slay Sothimus the Brigand, who leads the desert marauders in the middle of Tak'Xiv. Bring a tank who can take their blows.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Sothimus the Brigand among the desert marauders in the middle of Tak'Xiv.
Return to Ruddish the Devout.
steps.says: Good. Now three toxic glands: of the air, of the sea and of the land.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Sothimus stands with his marauders always (the guide's comes after hours of farming them).

quests.name: Three Toxic Glands
quests.offer: Three plagued creatures carry the glands: a plagued forest drake in south Toxxulia, a plagued siren at any siren camp, a plagued kobold hunter in the Stonebrunt Mountains.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the plagued forest drake in south Toxxulia, near Shrixiv, for the toxic gland of the air.
Kill a plagued siren at the siren camps for the toxic gland of the sea.
Kill the plagued kobold hunter in the Stonebrunt Mountains for the toxic gland of the land.
Bring the three glands to Ruddish the Devout.
steps.says: I have fused them into a rune. Its words are nonsense. Find what they mean in the Stonebrunt Mountains.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Rune of the Plagued
quests.offer: "...evarg yretaw sih ot mih nruter dna ekal eht morf erutaerc degniw eht kees..." Backwards, it reads: seek the winged creature from the lake, and return him to his watery grave.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Read the rune by the large rock on the lake's north shore, near the Grizz cave's east door, in the Stonebrunt Mountains.

events.text: The rune burns clean in your hands: its words now read true. Something stirs under the lake.

steps.journal: Kill the dragon Cyrcalis at the lake and take a scale.
Bring the scale of Cyrcalis and the rune to Ruddish the Devout.
steps.says: The dragon is in its grave again. Take your reward.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's four debuffing runes (Frost, Poison, Fire, Lightning) are not in: Cyrcalis is fought as he is. The lake's place is the server's Cyrcalis's.

quests.name: Lilla's Husband
quests.offer: Lilla, on the west edge of the lake in Rivervale by a boulder, has lost her husband. Help her.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Lilla on the west edge of the lake in Rivervale, by a boulder.
steps.says: Biddleby! He went out the east gate, two hills north. Take him his pie: he never could resist it. Mind the werehunters.

steps.journal: Find Biddleby two hills north of the east gate of Rivervale and give him the pie.
steps.says: Pie? PIE? I am no halfling any more!

steps.journal: Kill what Biddleby has become.
Return to Ruddish the Devout.
steps.says: Go to the blessing rock, where your blessings were given. Something waits there.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Biddleby stands on the hill always (the guide's comes from instantly to two hours); the pie is Lilla's (the guide does not say whose).

quests.name: The Avatar of Hate
quests.offer: Go back to the blessing rock across the river. The Avatar of Hate will come. Kill him, and give what he carries to Erollisi Marr.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Walk on the flat white rock across the river from Ruddish, by the tall square stone.

events.text: The air turns red. The Avatar of Hate rises, and his minions with him!

steps.journal: Kill the Avatar of Hate and take a medallion of Innoruk.
Give the medallion to Erollisi Marr by the rock.
steps.says: Love wins over hate. Go to Eripolus, on the south side of the lake by the Shon-To Monastery.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/good-healer.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The Avatar of Hate and Erollisi Marr stand by the rock always (the guide's come by the rock's popup and after the avatar leaves). Eripolus is the server's Ediopolus.

quests.name: The Recruiter
quests.offer: Zentar Reese spoke of you. Your path is walked; now the epic. Ozmo da Basher has work only the strongest can do. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go. Do not come back weak.

steps.journal: Find Ozmo da Basher at Oggok Gate, a five-minute run west of Kerplunk.
steps.says: Me could kill you without trying. Wands and branches first. Take token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-5-evil/L49, so a Group 5 warrior is sent on. The Ozmo's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.name: The Recruiter
quests.offer: Count Luvincius spoke of you. Your path is walked; now the epic. Ozmo da Basher has work only the strongest can do. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go. Do not come back weak.

steps.journal: Find Ozmo da Basher at Oggok Gate, a five-minute run west of Kerplunk.
steps.says: Me could kill you without trying. Wands and branches first. Take token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-6-evil/L49, so a Group 6 shadowknight is sent on. The Ozmo's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.name: Wands and Branches
quests.offer: Me could kill you without trying. Instead: two summoner's wands from the frogloks of south-west Burial Mounds, and two enchanted treant branches from south-west Guardian Forest.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill froglok slayers and inquisitors by the river in south-west Burial Mounds for two summoner's wands.
Kill the treant defenders and diviners on the stonehenge hill in south-west Guardian Forest for two enchanted treant branches.
Bring the wands, the branches and the token to Ozmo da Basher.
steps.says: Good. Now the fire basilisks of Lavastorm have ore. Me want what the ore calls up.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Ozmo is FrontiersForge's Ozmo da basher (the guide's Ozma Da Basher). The treants' camp: let the treant prisoner reach the stones, the guide says.

quests.name: The Megametamilipizon
quests.offer: Smoldering bedrock, mesothermal platinum, epithermal gold, from the fire basilisks. Drop them in the lava where the land dips, in the middle of Lavastorm. Kill what comes out.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill fire basilisks in Lavastorm for smoldering bedrock.
Kill fire basilisks for mesothermal platinum.
Kill fire basilisks for epithermal gold.
Drop the three ores into the lava where the land dips, in the middle of Lavastorm.

events.text: The ores melt into the lava. It boils, and something vast and many-legged climbs out of it: the Megametamilipizon!

steps.journal: Kill the Megametamilipizon and take its mandible.
Bring the Megametamilipizon's mandible to Ozmo da Basher.
steps.says: Ha! You strong.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The named millipedes are not in: the Megametamilipizon rises when the ores melt.

quests.name: Four Sashes
quests.offer: Desert marauders in the middle of Tak'Xiv wear sashes. Bring four. They hit hard and come in packs.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill desert marauders in the middle of Tak'Xiv for four sashes.
Bring the four sashes to Ozmo da Basher.
steps.says: Tilvyis, in the south of Neriak west of the coachman, want you now.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Breastplate and the Leggings
quests.offer: Ozmo sends me a fighter? Then fight for me. A siren's chest in the Vastly Deep holds a breastplate; the Taksehir crystal runners of the north Great Waste carry leggings. Bring both.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill enchanting sirens at the siren camp of the Vastly Deep (east) for a waterlogged key.
Open the waterlogged chest at the siren camp of the Vastly Deep (east) with the key.
Kill Taksehir crystal runners in the north of the Great Waste for the leggings of superiority.
Bring the breastplate and the leggings to Tilvyis.
steps.says: Now boots of excellence, and a ghostly goo besides.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's chest gives the Breastplate of Superiority itself; here it gives an unfinished one, and Tilvyis's reward is the finished Breastplate of Superiority.

quests.name: Boots of Excellence
quests.offer: Boots of excellence: the frosteye goblins wear them. And one ghostly goo from the undead of Centaur Valley.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill frosteye goblins at their camps for boots of excellence.
Kill the wandering ghosts by the broken bridge in east Centaur Valley, up the river from Blackwater, for ghostly goo.
Bring the boots and the goo to Tilvyis.
steps.says: Last: the gloves of power and protection, from the animated lava of south-east Lavastorm.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The boots are the database's boots of excellence. The guide's "TFG camps" are taken for the frosteye goblins' (ours).

quests.name: Gloves of Power and Protection
quests.offer: The animated lava of south-east Lavastorm carries the gloves of power and protection. Bring them, and a group: you will need it.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill animated lava in south-east Lavastorm for the gloves of power and protection.
Bring the gloves to Tilvyis.
steps.says: All four. And now, let us see if you deserve them!

steps.journal: Defeat Tilvyis.
Speak with Tilvyis when he stands again.
steps.says: Ha! You hit like a troll. The breastplate is yours. Go and see Ozmo.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Tilvyis is made attackable by this set's seed and rises again. The Breastplate of Superiority is made like a level 60 breastplate of the database (the guide: 420 AC, 40 stamina, 100 or more hit points).

quests.name: Graal the Leviathan
quests.offer: A sea serpent eats every Neriak spy in Qeynos. Graal the Leviathan, on the coast north-west of Qeynos. Bring a large force, and bring me its scale.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Tell Ozmo da Basher about the breastplate.
steps.says: Good. Tilvyis has another job. Go back.

steps.journal: Run up the coast from the castle to the north-west of Qeynos, where Graal the Leviathan hunts.

events.text: The sea heaves. A serpent as long as a ship comes out of the water: Graal the Leviathan!

steps.journal: Kill Graal the Leviathan and take a sea serpent's scale.
Bring the sea serpent's scale to Tilvyis.
steps.says: No more dead spies. Take this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Graal stands on the coast always (the guide's moves between land and water, and heals when it ports; its runes are not in).

quests.name: The Ravenous Bear
quests.offer: Something terrorizes the elves of Tethelin. Go north to the circle of bluish ice in the middle of Fayspire Gate, and see.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find the circle of bluish ice in the middle of Fayspire Gate and step into it.

events.text: The ice groans under you. A ravenous bear comes out of the blue!

steps.journal: Kill the ravenous bear.
Find Gelledyn, the only white-faced one, in Tethelin.
steps.says: A bear made mad by vampires. Randarith, Raldarith and Quil'Eyne hide in the Greyvax Caves, north-west. Bring me proof of them.

events.text: Vampires walk the woods of Tethelin.

steps.journal: Return to Tilvyis.
steps.says: Vampires! Then Neriak wants their secrets.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Quil'Eyne's Journal
quests.offer: In the Greyvax Caves: the blood of Randarith and Raldarith, and Quil'Eyne's journal. Bring an army, petters most of all.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Randarith in the Greyvax Caves for his blood. He hits hard but falls fast.
Kill Raldarith in the Greyvax Caves for his blood. Nearly nothing hurts him.
Keep Quil'Eyne in the basement of the Greyvax Caves and kill him for quil`eyne's journal.
Bring the two bloods and Quil'Eyne's journal to Tilvyis.
steps.says: Neriak will be pleased. Go to the monastery of Shon-To, north-east of Hatespike, and speak with Ediopolus by the lake.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-tank.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The journal is the database's Quil`Eyne's Journal; the bloods Randerith's and Raldithar's blood. Ty'lvis is Tilvyis (the server's Tilvyis S`Lynx); Epidopolous is the server's Ediopolus.

quests.name: The Recruiter
quests.offer: Gribble Greencog spoke of you. Your path is walked; now the epic. Rashiroz the Rogue has work only the strongest can do. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go. Do not come back weak.

steps.journal: Find Rashiroz the Rogue in the middle of North Kithicor.
steps.says: Glowing crystals from the Taksehir miners first. Carry my token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-melee.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a path group: it follows 30,40,49/group-4-evil/L49, so a Group 4 rogue is sent on. The Rashiroz's token opens the episodes (the first hand-in takes it).

quests.name: Crystals and Branches
quests.offer: Two glowing crystals from the Taksehir miners in the west of the Great Waste, then two enchanted treant branches from south-west Guardian Forest.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Taksehir miners in the west of the Great Waste for two glowing crystals.
Bring the two glowing crystals and my token to Rashiroz the Rogue.
steps.says: Now the branches.

steps.journal: Kill the treant defenders and diviners on the stonehenge hill in south-west Guardian Forest for two enchanted treant branches.
Bring the two branches to Rashiroz the Rogue.
steps.says: Now the heart and brain of Aktana the Flamekissed, in the east of Lavastorm, and his soul.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-melee.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's treant camp asks the treant and goblin prisoners be let live; not here.

quests.name: Aktana the Flamekissed
quests.offer: Aktana the Flamekissed sleeps in a gargoyle statue in the east of Lavastorm. Give it a heart, then a brain, and bring me his soul.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill animated lava in the east of Lavastorm until one holds the heart of Aktana.
Place the heart in the gargoyle statue of Aktana, north of the lava.

events.text: The statue takes the heart and stirs. Round the mountain to the north, gargoyle patrollers wake.

steps.journal: Kill the gargoyle patrollers north round the mountain until the fire imp protector comes, and take the brain.
Bring the brain to the statue of Aktana.

events.text: The statue cracks open. Aktana the Flamekissed steps out, burning!

steps.journal: Kill Aktana the Flamekissed and take Aktana's soul.
Bring Aktana's soul to Rashiroz the Rogue.
steps.says: A soul worth stealing.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-melee.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide says to return the soul to Magi'Kot (the good casters' NPC): Rashiroz here.

quests.name: The Brigand's Purse
quests.offer: Bandits come to Freeport's north gate every few hours. Let them rob you, kill their brigand for his coin purse, and have a word with one of his henchmen.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Wait outside Freeport's north gate, by the signpost, with 500 tunar on you for the bandits.

events.text: Three bandits come up the road and brush past you. Your purse is lighter! The brigand in the middle has it.

steps.journal: Kill the bandit brigand and take the coin purse.
Speak with one of the brigand's henchmen.

Kill enchanting sirens at the siren camp of the Vastly Deep (east) for a waterlogged key.
Open the waterlogged chest at the siren camp of the Vastly Deep (east) with the key.
Kill enchanting sirens at the siren camp of West Toxx (south-west) for a waterlogged key.

Bring Vylinnuza's soul to Rashiroz the Rogue.
steps.says: The tide, in my pocket. Take your share.

steps.journal: Go to the hill by the great depression in the middle of the North Barren Coast.

steps.says: Now Magi'Kot again: he will take you to the Plane of Sky for the last summoning.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-melee.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Boldunder's place is EQOA-Data's map point laid over Odus (the seed's fit).

Kill the treant defenders and diviners on the stonehenge hill in south-west Guardian Forest for two enchanted treant branches.
Bring the crystals, the branches and my token to Animator Jen'Tylis.
steps.says: Now the froglok herbalist at the bottom of Guk: he brews what I need.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-caster.json, Episode 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Kill froglok channelers in Guk for a spotted tongue.
Kill froglok channelers in Guk for congealed swamp water.
Kill fungal cavaliers and hunters deep in Guk for mycanoid spores.
Bring the three ingredients to the froglok herbalist at the bottom of Guk, past two bridges.

steps.says: Exactly as I hoped.

quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Kill Sothimus the Brigand among the desert marauders in the middle of Tak'Xiv and take his coin purse.
Bring the coin purse to Animator Jen'Tylis.
steps.says: Now an engraved ring from a siren's chest, and a plagued siren's gland while you are there.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-caster.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Sothimus stands with his marauders always (the guide's comes after farming them).

Open the waterlogged chest at one of the siren camps with the key.
Kill a plagued siren at the siren camps for its toxic gland.
Bring the engraved ring to Animator Jen'Tylis.
steps.says: Now find the ghost of Ualdius, near the ice cave of Vox Castle.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-caster.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

steps.says: Teledic killed me. In Vox Castle: through the bridge, the room of four passages, north to the fountain, then the north wall's right passage.

Return to Animator Jen'Tylis.
steps.says: Good. Now Calidux, in the dungeon of Qeynos Prison, next to Ulthud the Wall.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-caster.json, Episode 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Teledic stands in his passage always (the guide's spawns as the player comes).

quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Give the toxic siren gland to Calidux in the dungeon of Qeynos Prison.
steps.says: With this I can weaken An Ancient Corpse. Slay it, and bring me its soul.

steps.journal: Go to the north of Basher's Enclave, where An Ancient Corpse rests.

events.text: The ground splits, and An Ancient Corpse rises!

steps.journal: Kill An Ancient Corpse and take its soul.
Bring the ancient corpse's soul to Calidux.

Bring Alizander's journal to Animator Jen'Tylis.

steps.journal: Find Severupidus in Freeport's casters' quarter.
steps.says: A pie? Bring me a mycanoid stem from the fungals of Guk and I will bake it.

Bring the mycanoid stem to Severupidus.
steps.says: One pie, fresh from the oven.

steps.journal: Take the pie to Biddleby, on the first hill south of the east gate of Rivervale.
steps.says: Pie! Tell the Animator his message is received.

steps.journal: Return to Animator Jen'Tylis in the Green Rift.
steps.says: Then he comes: the Avatar of Hate, here in the Green Rift.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/60/evil-caster.json, Episode 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Serverudipus is the server's Severupidus (the guide spells him both ways).

Bring the talisman to Animator Jen'Tylis.
steps.says: Now the Avatar of Love, west of Ruddish the Devout by the north river of the Spider Mines.

Kill the treant defenders and diviners on the stonehenge hill in south-west Guardian Forest for two enchanted treant branches.
Bring the wands, the branches and my token to Seer Yalgima.

quests.offer: Find the three pages of pardon in Guk, give them to the High Shaman, and keep his prisoner alive.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

Kill frogloks in Guk until the Elder Froglok Guk Diviner comes, for the second page.
Kill fungal cavaliers and hunters deep in Guk until an elder fungal comes, for the third page.
Bring the three pages of pardon to the High Shaman in Guk.

Speak with the High Shaman again.
steps.says: He is safe. Go back to the one who sent you.

steps.journal: Return to Seer Yalgima in Basher's Enclave.
steps.says: The prisoner lives. You are ready.

Return to Seer Yalgima.
steps.says: It is gone. Take your reward.

steps.journal: Answer the second spirit, who comes from the west.
steps.says: Why do you disturb the dead?

choices.says: Power? Then wait, and be judged again.
Sent? By whom? Wait, and be judged again.
Troubled, yes. You see truly.

steps.journal: Answer the third spirit, who comes from the south-east.
steps.says: What do you know of us?

choices.says: Then wait, and be judged again.
Escaped, to the pirates' island of Cape Dreg. Bring it back.
Lost? Wait, and be judged again.

steps.says: Cape Dreg, then. The island with the pirate ship.
